text: Optical circuit switching (OCS) is attractive for AI data-center networks. Which statement about it is correct?
choices: OCS can buffer photons indefinitely, unlike electronic switches
OCS reconfigures in nanoseconds, faster than any electronic switch
OCS is best for short, unpredictable web flows
OCS routes long-lived 'elephant' flows without OEO conversion at each hop, saving ~10x power, but it cannot buffer photons
explanation: OCS carries long-lived flows optically end-to-end, avoiding per-hop optical-electrical-optical conversion and saving ~10x switching power, but it fundamentally cannot buffer photons and so needs schedulable traffic. MEMS OCS reconfigures in 5-25 ms (not nanoseconds) and suits predictable elephant flows rather than bursty web traffic.
